Hi Ari,

Thanks again for taking the time to join the demo earlier today - really appreciated the thoughtful questions from you and Samantha. Quick recap and a proposed POC approach so we can get alignment on success criteria, timeline, and owners. I attached a one-page POC plan (Finovate_POC_plan_v1.pdf) and a short checklist.

High-level recap:
- Use case: customer support summarization + contextual retrieval for agent assist across claims and account support.
- Key constraints: latency target ~150ms p95 for short responses, model privacy (no data retained for training), and S3-based historical data ingestion.

Proposed POC (goal: validate latency, quality, and integration)
1) Success criteria (must pass for pilot to be considered successful)
   - Qualitative: avg agent satisfaction >= 4/5 on 50 sampled interactions during evaluation window
   - Quantitative: model generates correct intent/entity extraction for >= 85% of sampled set
   - Performance: p95 latency <= 200ms for typical 512-token request pattern during peak load (simulated)
2) Evaluation plan
   - Week 0 (prep, 3 days): data access & ingest (S3), create sample prompts, baseline metrics
   - Week 1-2 (integration spike, 10 business days): deploy evaluation model, iterate on prompt templates, run synthetic load tests with Redwood Dedicated test pool
   - Week 3-4 (evaluation window, 10 business days): run live evals on anonymized traffic and collect quality metrics and agent feedback
3) Timeline & ownership
   - Kickoff: propose Tue Mar 2, 10:00 AM PST (60 min) - will cover integration steps and test plan
   - Redwood owners: Marissa Cole (AM, project lead), Dylan Brooks (Solutions Engineer, integration + load testing)
   - Finovate owners: Ari Patel (product owner), Samantha Lin (engineering lead)
4) Deliverables
   - POC deployment runbook + integration notes
   - Evaluation report with sample prompts, quantitative metrics, and recommended next steps

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Can you confirm: (a) access to an S3 bucket or sample export for ingest, (b) whether the evaluation traffic can be anonymized copies?
- If procurement needs to be looped now for an MOU, please let me know and we can accelerate pricing/terms.
- Confirm whether Tue Mar 2 at 10 AM PST works for the kickoff - I'll send a calendar invite upon confirmation.

Links & attachments:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/8421
- Draft POC plan: attached (Finovate_POC_plan_v1.pdf)

Thanks - looking forward to getting started.

Best,
